q: The Onsager reciprocal relations in non-equilibrium thermodynamics state that near equilibrium, the phenomenological coefficients Lᵢⱼ (relating fluxes to thermodynamic forces) satisfy:
exp: Onsager reciprocal relations (1931, Nobel Prize 1968): Lᵢⱼ = Lⱼᵢ. This symmetry follows from time-reversal invariance of microscopic dynamics (detailed balance). Onsager relations constrain transport coefficients (e.g., Seebeck and Peltier coefficients in thermoelectricity are equal).
